title: FisFisPortalPerm
description: a plugin that offers an authorization requirement to enter the portal
body:
FisFisPortalPerm is a lightweight and easy-to-use plugin that gives you full control over interdimensional travel on your server. With this plugin, you can manage your players' access to dangerous dimensions like the Nether and the End through a simple permission system, enhancing both game balance and server security.

**Key Features:**

**Permission-Based Travel Control:** Control whether players can use Nether and End portals with the dedicated permissions ffpp.nether and ffpp.end.

**Fully Configurable:** Permissions are set to op by default, putting access control entirely in your hands.

**Lightweight and Performance-Friendly:** Designed to be highly efficient, ensuring a smooth experience without taxing your server's resources.

**Seamless Integration:** Works perfectly with other plugins without causing any conflicts.

**Usage and Permissions:**

The plugin contains no commands. All permissions must be managed manually using a permission plugin like LuckPerms or PermissionsEx.

Permission Node Description Default

**ffpp.nether** Gives a player permission to travel to the Nether. false

**ffpp.end** Gives a player permission to travel to the End. false
